ali: Quick flag  CI failed on the new Optimize migration PR. Small but blocking: a doc snippet uses the pre-0.9 QuantProfile API and there's a 404 to /optkit/quant-profiles.

meera: Which snippet?

ali: In docs/optimize/migration.md. Current code:
```python
from redwood.optimize import QuantProfile
q = QuantProfile(precision='int8', calibrate=True)
```

oscar: New API uses dtype + calibrator. Replace with:
```python
from redwood.optimize import QuantProfile, DefaultCalibrator
q = QuantProfile(dtype='qint8', calibrator=DefaultCalibrator())
```

meera: I'll patch the link to /optimize/quantization and swap the snippet. I'll also grep for `kv_cache_enabled` -> `kv_prefetch: 'auto'`.

ci-bot: PR #742  snippet-exec: 1 failed, link-checker: 1 broken link. Artifacts: https://ci.redwood.example/742/artifacts

oscar: Add a tiny smoke test under docs/tests/snippets/quant_profile_smoke.py so snippet-exec catches this next time. I can add that after your PR.

ali: Please also add a short migration bullet: "SDK <0.9 -> >=0.9: QuantProfile(precision=...) -> QuantProfile(dtype=...) and use calibrator objects instead of calibrate=True."

meera: Will do. Tagging @oscar once PR is up so you can add the test quickly.

ali: Thanks  holding the docs sync until CI green.
